asian_branch_note: SWEEP/RANGE/TREND branch behavior belongs to this layer

primitives.BOS: close beyond the last confirmed swing without an opposing-bias flip
primitives.ENGULFING: opposite-colour bar whose body strictly engulfs the prior body
primitives.LIQUIDITY_SWEEP: bar trades beyond the reference level and CLOSES back on the origin side
primitives.MORNING_STAR: bearish bar; middle body <= 0.3 of it; bullish close above first-bar body midpoint
primitives.MSS: close beyond the last confirmed opposing swing while bias is opposite (flip)
primitives.PIN_BAR: dominant wick >= 2.0x body and >= 0.66 of range
